name: OG Image CN
description: Customizable Open Graph image components for React, installed through the shadcn CLI.
descriptionLong: OG Image CN is a shadcn-compatible registry of Open Graph image components for React. The CLI copies each template into your codebase so you can change its layout, content, and metadata without a separate design tool.
features: The shadcn CLI copies components into your repository
Built for React and Next.js metadata APIs
